tasks.title: single-leg arb fill counts as directional exposure; positions net per leg, never per pair
tasks.finish: src/paper_ledger.py nets paper fills per leg (market + token_id): only a buy and a sell of the same token offset each other, the two tokens of an arb pair never do, and a row without token_id is its own unknown leg. load_state(market, token_id) reports open_positions as open legs, leg_already_open for that exact token, and exposure_usd / leg_exposure_usd at each leg's average fill price (1 USD per share when notional is missing). risk_gate.evaluate exempts the max_open_positions cap only when state leg_already_open is True; another open leg of the same market does not exempt. pytest passes offline. tasks.title: scanner picks outcome IDs by Gamma version (v2 positionIds, v1 clobTokenIds); missing or unknown version rejects the market
tasks.finish: src/scanner.py select_token_ids(market) is pure and offline: version v2 reads positionIds and v1 reads clobTokenIds (each as a list or a JSON-encoded list), even when both fields are present and differ. On the same market and the same leg (market + token_id; a missing token_id is treated as possibly the same token): an uncancelled own paper quote (quotes.jsonl status open) on the opposite side vetoes cross_side_same_leg (no time window); an own paper fill on the opposite side within WASH_WINDOW_S = 300 s (future-stamped counts as inside) vetoes wash_same_market; Intent.counterparty naming our own account, pod role (Maker/Executor) or one of our strategies vetoes self_trade_structure.
